field: Build @emsenn/governance-topology: incumbency-as-installation over stages (recognition + induction -> dignitas) and succession (relief; dignitas non moritur). Sub-agent dispatch as delegation morphism: rho_a' g' -- sub-incumbency under the parent office with a bounded sub-scope G' subset G subsetneq A_O, accountability non-transfer (stays with parent), revocable. pyfars Phase 5 / delegation-transport-via-beck-chevalley.

THE north star -- the orchestrator writes prompts to spawned coding agents.
